answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the echo of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the river of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
